name: Convex Free
free_limit: Free plan: 0.5 GB database storage, 1 GB database I/O/month, 1 million function calls/month, 20 GB-hours action compute/month and 1 GB file storage
watch_out: Free limits are measured across the team (not per project); includes 0.5 GB search storage and 3,000 query-GBs/month for search. Exceeding Free caps for a sustained period may cause function calls or mutations to fail; the separate Starter plan can charge usage-based overages. The free allowance is ongoing, not a trial.
